_comment: WFS layer catalogue. Each source has its own endpoint, typeName prefix and WFS version. 'filter' restricts national layers to the Copenhagen area by attribute after download.

layers.name: sp_kloakoplande
layers.note: Per-catchment sewer system status (fælles-/spildevands-/separatkloakeret), receiving treatment plant, impervious fraction. The backbone dataset for 'what kind of sewer is under this block'.

layers.name: skp_bassiner_pladser_kk
layers.note: Planned/claimed detention volumes. Has klima_id joining to the Spildevandsplan project pages.

layers.name: skp_veje_tunneller_kk
layers.note: Includes skybrudsledninger and tunnel alignments. klima_id joins to project pages.

layers.name: skp_deloplande
layers.note: Sub-division of the seven cloudburst catchments.

layers.name: skp_skybrudsoplande
layers.note: The top-level water catchments used to organise the whole plan.

layers.name: skp_terraenaend
layers.note: Where the surface itself is reshaped to steer water.

layers.name: lar_registreringer
layers.note: Registered on-site infiltration - the decentralised half of the rainwater story.

layers.name: dp_regnvandsafledning_l
layers.note: Swales, channels, trenches in public space.

layers.name: dp_regnvandsafledning_p
layers.note: Inlets, gullies and similar point assets in public space.

layers.name: vand_oversigtskort
layers.note: The visible receiving waters - where the invisible system finally discharges.

layers.name: grundvand_pejlinger_2021
layers.note: Constrains how deep anything can be built and where infiltration actually works.

layers.name: terraen_minus_gvs
layers.note: Depth to groundwater - the practical ceiling on basin depth.

sources.name: Miljøstyrelsen MiljøGIS - Vandområdeplan 3, basisanalyse 2019
sources.note: National coverage. These are the DISCHARGE END of the system - where Copenhagen's sewers actually release to water bodies. Filtered to the metropolitan municipalities on download.

layers.name: vp3_basis_2019_punkt_rbu_udl
layers.note: Combined-sewer overflow structures and stormwater outfalls. 'bgv_type' is the structure type, 'vol_sb' the associated basin volume in m3. This is the national PULS-derived register - the closest thing to an open list of where sewage overflows to the harbour.

layers.name: vp3_basis_2019_punkt_rens_udl
layers.note: 'godk_pe' is approved capacity in person-equivalents; 'rens_sta' the treatment stage.

layers.name: vp3basis2019_badevand
layers.note: The public-health consequence of overflow events; useful as a validation layer.
